group_manifest.proof_strategy: Prove the initialization entailment by unfolding the head and fresh-node predicates and choosing the empty prefix; prove the loop entailment by decomposing the non-null suffix and extending the traversed segment by one node; prove return by reducing the null suffix, constructing the appended singleton node, composing it with the traversed segment, and rebuilding the head view. Use only existing proved declarations from QCIPLib.xizi.xizi_single_link_common.xizi_single_link_lib.

group_entry.grouping_reason: All three obligations are the ordered initialization, loop-step, and return phases of the same singly-linked-list append invariant. They use one coherent xizi_sll/xizi_sllseg lemma family, total only 3 witnesses (within the limit of 12), and can be proved sequentially by one worker without cross-group helpers; a single group is therefore the minimum valid grouping.

proof_of_AppendSingleLinkList_entail_wit.witness_instantiation: First branch: next is the head's stored successor, l1a := nil, l1b := l. Second branch: l1b := l.
proof_of_AppendSingleLinkList_entail_wit.space_plan: Unfold xizi_sll_head/generic_sll_head and xizi_sll_node; retain the two next-field cells, use xizi_sllseg linklist_pre linklist_pre nil as emp, and frame xizi_sll next l plus the fresh node cell.
proof_of_AppendSingleLinkList_entail_wit.pure_plan: The head and node predicate conjuncts supply linklist_pre <> 0 and linklist_node_pre <> 0; list identities reduce by simplification.

proof_of_AppendSingleLinkList_entail_wit.witness_instantiation: Decomposition branch: l1b_2 = next_2 :: lnext, choose next := successor(next_2), l1a := l1a_2 ++ [node], l1b := lnext. Already-decomposed branch: choose l1a := l1a_2 ++ [node], l1b := l0.
proof_of_AppendSingleLinkList_entail_wit.space_plan: Apply xizi_sll_not_zero to the non-null suffix, create xizi_sllseg node next_2 [node] with xizi_sllseg_len1, then compose it with the old prefix using xizi_sllseg_sllseg; preserve the fresh-node cell by framing.
proof_of_AppendSingleLinkList_entail_wit.pure_plan: PreH2/node <> 0 discharges xizi_sllseg_len1; PreH6/PreH7 discharges xizi_sll_not_zero. Substitute l1b_2 = next_2 :: lnext/l0 and use PreH1 plus app_assoc to establish the new list decomposition.

proof_of_AppendSingleLinkList_return_wit.witness_instantiation: After rebuilding the complete list, decompose its non-null root and choose q as the stored successor of linklist_pre; the tail list is l ++ [linklist_node_pre].
proof_of_AppendSingleLinkList_return_wit.space_plan: Use next = 0 with xizi_sll_zero to derive l1b = nil; use xizi_sll_len1 for the new node ending at NULL, xizi_sll_cons for node -> linklist_node_pre, and xizi_sllseg_sll to combine the traversed prefix with [node; linklist_node_pre]. Apply xizi_sll_not_zero at the root and unfold xizi_sll_head to expose the required head cell and tail list.
proof_of_AppendSingleLinkList_return_wit.pure_plan: PreH2, PreH3/PreH4, and PreH5 discharge all non-null premises. PreH1, l1b = nil, the list equation returned by xizi_sll_not_zero, app_assoc, and constructor injectivity yield the tail equality l0 = l ++ [linklist_node_pre].
